turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sanibonani. Kule module sizobheka ukufunda kokuqala.
turns.en: Hello. In this module we will look at emergent reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Emergent reading starts in Grade R.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ngokujwayelekile, ukufundisa ukufunda ebungeni R kuye kube sengathi akwenziwa ngendlela ehlelekile, kanti ilapho okufanele kuqiniswe kakhulu umgogodlo wokufunda ukuze balungele ukufunda ebungeni lokuqala.
turns.en: Usually, teaching reading in Grade R seems as if it is not done in a structured way, whereas that is where the backbone of reading should be strengthened the most so that they are ready for reading in Grade 1.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: After finishing the work of this module

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda umsebenzi wale module uzokwazi ukuthi
turns.en: After finishing the work of this module you will know

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: kuyini ukufunda kokuqala, kubaluleke ngani kanti futhi kufundiswa kanjani.
turns.en: what is emergent reading, why is it important and also how is it taught.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kuhlanganisa kanjani imisebenzi yansuku zonke lokufundisa ukufunda ebangeni R?
turns.en: How does it integrate daily activities with teaching reading in Grade R?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ihlelwa kanjani imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa ikhono lokufunda ngokudlala imidlalo nabafundi kanye nokusebenzisa umculo.
turns.en: How are activities planned to develop the skill of reading by playing games with learners and using music.
